(English summary for your records:)

I am an EU consumer resident in Germany. This is not a refund request under your refund policy. It is a formal notice of withdrawal under statutory consumer law, which gives me 14 days from conclusion of a digital service contract to withdraw without giving a reason. The renewal on 2026-03-10 is a new paid contract period, so the withdrawal period runs until 2026-03-24. Today is 2026-03-15, which is within that period.

My December refund therefore has no bearing on this.

2. I have not used the service since the renewal, so no deduction for services rendered applies (Art. 14(3)).

3. The law requires reimbursement within 14 days of receiving this notice, using the same payment method (Art. 13).

Please process the reimbursement of INV-000164 ($24.00, paid 2026-03-10) to my original payment method and confirm in your reply. Please also end the subscription so it does not renew on 2026-04-10.

If you're unable to process a statutory withdrawal yourself, please note that refusing it isn't the same as declining a goodwill refund. In that case I'd need a written reason referencing the legal basis for the refusal, since I'll otherwise have to raise it with the Verbraucherzentrale.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen,
